animations.name: Medium Punch Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Perform ONE SINGLE slow, deliberate heavy crouching lunging punch across the clip (strictly one punch only, never a jab first or second punch), pure body motion only in empty air: staying low on the baseline without standing up, he winds up by coiling his torso back and pulling his right shoulder and fist back while loading his legs; then he smoothly lunges low forward along the baseline and drives ONE heavy straight horizontal right punch to full reach (arm straight, fist closed, left arm tucked by his waist); brief hold at full reach, then smooth retraction back into the starting crouch guard pose. Preserve exact face, hairstyle, varsity jacket, jeans, sneakers, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
